__comment: Canonical tako_search_advanced wire fixture for the generated docs/TOOLS.md samples (spec: 2026-08-26-model-facing-surface-redesign, 'TOOLS.md output rendering'). Shape mirrors POST /api/v1/answer, which is the tool's include_answer branch and a superset of the search branch: it adds answer and structured_output on top of cards[] and web_results[]. The ANSWER path is the one fixture on purpose — a search-path sample can never show `answer`, which is the field this tool alone publishes and the reason the branch exists. The request it stands for sets include_answer, output_schema, data.include_contents with max_rows 3, and web.include_contents, so one sample carries the fields only this tool can return: inlined card rows, web page text, the synthesized answer and its filled schema. NOT `related`: POST /v1/answer accepts include_related and returns no related field (verified against staging 2026-08-31), so a sample carrying both would depict a response the API cannot produce. `related`'s shape is in the outputSchema block on this page. Deliberately small — 1 card, 1 web result, 3 rows. Regenerating TOOLS.md runs this through the real projection + renderer; do not hand-edit the samples there.

content.data: SANTA CLARA, Calif. — NVIDIA today reported revenue for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 of $81.6 billion, up 85% from a year ago. Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 89% from a year ago.
